description: ROADMAP item 7. The stat grid renders rain_expected and onset_window as TILES, and nothing measured their length until one reached 149 characters. The ceiling is read off the record rather than chosen: over the 32 days to 2026-09-11 every value but one was 48 or fewer, and every value after the call split was longer. Recorded as a finding, never refused -- a bound tight enough to reject a wordy but correct forecast leaves the day with no forecast at all.
